subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for real Telegram owner-session delivery proof before merge, or is source-level proof enough for this session/message-delivery change?
rationale: The code path looks like the right narrow fix, but the changed behavior is visible in Telegram topic delivery and source-level tests cannot prove the real transport/session result.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, but then own the risk that real transport/session delivery still drops or misroutes completion messages.

options.title: Pause For Broader Contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths before changing delivery routing.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest visible history across heartbeat wake and subagent delivery boundaries that need to be weighed for this proof-sufficiency choice.
